overview.zh: 營收與現金流同比成長，但淨利及EPS的高增幅受到去年一次性稅項影響，不能全部視為營運改善。公司附錄提供去年GAAP與非GAAP調節；本表保留GAAP比較，將基期因素另作解釋。
overview.en: Revenue and cash flow grew YoY, while large net-income and EPS growth reflects a prior-year one-time tax charge. The appendix reconciles prior GAAP and non-GAAP results; this table retains GAAP comparisons and explains the base effect separately.

eps.zh: 去年同期GAAP EPS為0.97，附錄調整後為1.64；不以非GAAP值偷偷替換同比基期。
eps.en: Prior GAAP EPS was 0.97 versus 1.64 adjusted in the appendix; the GAAP comparison base is not silently replaced.

net_income.zh: 去年同期一次性稅項10,246百萬USD壓低GAAP基期，高同比增幅需考慮此因素。
net_income.en: A prior USD 10,246m one-time tax charge depressed the GAAP base; not all headline growth is operational.

cfo.zh: 單季由全年現金流減九個月值計算，不以全年數字冒充本季。
cfo.en: Single-quarter cash flow is full year minus nine months, not the annual amount.
